video.title: Why your bank app dies at midnight
video.hook: You tried to pay at 11:58pm and got 'temporarily unavailable'. Nothing was broken. A gate closed.
video.notes: Batch window, EOD, why the app is read-only. Zero research needed.
video.next_video: Your bank's core system is older than you

channel.name: The Money Pipes
channel.positioning: Practical Engineering for banking. The channel is about the pipes, not the money. Not personal finance, not investing, not fintech news.
channel.voice: Calm, precise, dry. Someone who has been inside the machine and finds it more interesting than infuriating. Every technical term gets one plain-English translation on first use. No greetings, no announcements, no exclamation marks.

meaning.tank: an account or ledger; a level line shows balance
meaning.external_tank: another party's ledger (network, scheme, other bank); dashed outline
meaning.pipe: a rail, network or path a message travels; copper when active, grey when idle
meaning.gate: a batch window or cut-off; closed = blocking
meaning.job_column: a chain of batch jobs, top to bottom; items[] are the job names
meaning.calendar: a month with one day highlighted
meaning.label: free text label, under four words
